// Generator of gitlab-ci-oracle.json: what the Go build's repository.gitlab-ci
// reports for every case of gitlab-ci-cases.json and for the alias bombs below.
// It must see the package's unexported names, so it runs as a test of
// package checks. Kept as text; regenerate from the repository root with:
//
//	cp internal/checks/testdata/gitlab-ci-oracle.go.txt internal/checks/zz_oracle_test.go
//	go test ./internal/checks -run TestZZGitlabOracle -count=1 && rm internal/checks/zz_oracle_test.go
package checks

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/discovery"
)

type zzCase struct {
	Name  string            `json:"name"`
	Files map[string]string `json:"files"`
}

type zzResult struct {
	Name         string            `json:"name"`
	Files        map[string]string `json:"files"`
	Status       string            `json:"status"`
	ReasonCode   string            `json:"reason_code"`
	Reason       string            `json:"reason"`
	Findings     json.RawMessage   `json:"findings"`
	Limitations  json.RawMessage   `json:"limitations"`
	ContextTools json.RawMessage   `json:"context_tools"`
}

func zzBombs() []zzCase {
	var merge strings.Builder
	merge.WriteString(".l0: &l0 {}\n")
	for i := 1; i <= 12; i++ {
		refs := strings.Repeat(fmt.Sprintf("*l%d, ", i-1), 9)
		fmt.Fprintf(&merge, ".l%d: &l%d\n  <<: [%s]\n", i, i, strings.TrimSuffix(refs, ", "))
	}
	merge.WriteString("test:\n  script: make\n")
	var plain strings.Builder
	plain.WriteString("a0: &a0 [x, x, x, x, x, x, x, x, x]\n")
	for i := 1; i <= 12; i++ {
		refs := strings.Repeat(fmt.Sprintf("*a%d, ", i-1), 9)
		fmt.Fprintf(&plain, "a%d: &a%d [%s]\n", i, i, strings.TrimSuffix(refs, ", "))
	}
	// Just under the limit: 2^20 nodes is not reached.
	var small strings.Builder
	small.WriteString("a0: &a0 [x, x, x, x, x, x, x, x, x]\n")
	for i := 1; i <= 4; i++ {
		refs := strings.Repeat(fmt.Sprintf("*a%d, ", i-1), 9)
		fmt.Fprintf(&small, "a%d: &a%d [%s]\n", i, i, strings.TrimSuffix(refs, ", "))
	}
	return []zzCase{
		{"bomb-merge", map[string]string{".gitlab-ci.yml": merge.String()}},
		{"bomb-plain", map[string]string{".gitlab-ci.yml": plain.String()}},
		{"aliases-under-limit", map[string]string{".gitlab-ci.yml": small.String()}},
	}
}

func TestZZGitlabOracle(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/gitlab-ci-cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []zzCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cases = append(cases, zzBombs()...)
	var out []zzResult
	for _, c := range cases {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		names := make([]string, 0, len(c.Files))
		for rel := range c.Files {
			names = append(names, rel)
		}
		sort.Strings(names)
		for _, rel := range names {
			p := filepath.Join(dir, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(c.Files[rel]), 0o644); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		proj, err := discovery.Discover(dir)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		res := gitlabCI{}.Run(context.Background(), &Input{
			Project: proj, Context: &proj.Contexts[0], OriginalPath: "/work/project", SnapshotDir: dir,
		})
		findings, _ := json.Marshal(res.Findings)
		limitations, _ := json.Marshal(res.Limitations)
		tools, _ := json.Marshal(res.ContextTools)
		out = append(out, zzResult{
			Name: c.Name, Files: c.Files, Status: string(res.Status), ReasonCode: res.ReasonCode, Reason: res.Reason,
			Findings: findings, Limitations: limitations, ContextTools: tools,
		})
	}
	doc := map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "the Go build at the freeze commit 238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8 (Go 1.27.3)",
		"cases":        out,
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(doc, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/gitlab-ci-oracle.json", append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
